Title: Drug Absorption
Description: Absorption describes how a drug enters the bloodstream from its administration site, influenced by formulation, route, and physiological barriers like membranes.

Title: Drug Distribution
Description: Distribution covers how the drug spreads through body compartments and tissues, often bound to proteins and passing selectively into organs.

Title: Drug Metabolism
Description: Metabolism transforms the parent compound into metabolites via enzymes, mainly in the liver, altering activity and facilitating excretion.

Title: Drug Excretion
Description: Excretion removes drug and metabolites, primarily through kidneys into urine, also via bile, sweat, or breath depending on properties.
